ISSUE DESCRIPTION:
Customer reports that ADAS displays a 'Sensor Blocked' warning when accelerating from a complete stop. Technician confirmed radar bracket micro-cracks and environmental fouling on the radome are present, satisfying the TPI criteria. All physical inspections have been completed and exactly match the TPI requirements.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Diagnostic assessment and calibration of the Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC). This procedure addresses the reported issue based on confirmed findings.

APPLICABLE TPI ENTRIES:
TPI 2075705/2 - Front Radar Sensor Weather Sensitivity
- Symptom Alignment: Perfectly matches confirmed customer complaint and diagnostic findings.
- Operating Conditions: Confirmed present when accelerating from a complete stop.
- Applicability: 2024-2026 Models.
- Prescribed Solution: Inspect front radar bracket and apply ceramic coating.

ISSUE DESCRIPTION:
Customer reports that the hybrid system warning light illuminates when ambient temperature exceeds 35°C. Megohmmeter testing confirms a high-voltage isolation breakdown due to moisture ingress in the main power cable. All physical inspections have been completed and exactly match the TPI requirements.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Diagnostic assessment and calibration of the Battery Management System (BMS). This procedure addresses the reported issue based on confirmed findings.

APPLICABLE TPI ENTRIES:
TPI 2040404/1 - High-Voltage Isolation Fault
- Symptom Alignment: Perfectly matches confirmed customer complaint and diagnostic findings.
- Operating Conditions: Confirmed present when ambient temperature exceeds 35°C.
- Applicability: 2024-2026 Models.
- Prescribed Solution: Check and replace high-voltage cabling for moisture ingress.

ISSUE DESCRIPTION:
Customer reports that the AC blows warm air from driver-side vents after parking the vehicle overnight in freezing temperatures. ODIS measuring value blocks confirm the V158 actuator is misaligned and fails end-stop calibration. All physical inspections have been completed and exactly match the TPI requirements.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Diagnostic assessment and calibration of the HVAC Control Module. This procedure addresses the reported issue based on confirmed findings.

APPLICABLE TPI ENTRIES:
TPI 2017315/2 - Left Blend Door Actuator Misalignment
- Symptom Alignment: Perfectly matches confirmed customer complaint and diagnostic findings.
- Operating Conditions: Confirmed present after parking the vehicle overnight in freezing temperatures.
- Applicability: 2024-2026 Models.
- Prescribed Solution: Perform end-stop calibration or replace flap motor.

ISSUE DESCRIPTION:
Customer reports that the display goes completely black and reboots after driving on unpaved or dusty roads. Diagnostic inspection has already confirmed high memory load during reverse engagement, directly matching the TPI operating conditions. All physical inspections have been completed and exactly match the TPI requirements.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Diagnostic assessment and calibration of the Infotainment Control Module (J794). This procedure addresses the reported issue based on confirmed findings.

APPLICABLE TPI ENTRIES:
TPI 2054771/5 - MIB3 Infotainment Display Blanking
- Symptom Alignment: Perfectly matches confirmed customer complaint and diagnostic findings.
- Operating Conditions: Confirmed present after driving on unpaved or dusty roads.
- Applicability: 2024-2026 Models.
- Prescribed Solution: Perform a software flash update to v14.2.1.

ISSUE DESCRIPTION:
Customer reports that there is harsh shifting from 2nd to 3rd gear when driving over speed bumps below 30 km/h. Fluid pressure logs show solenoid N215 failing to hold pressure during the 2-3 upshift, as exactly outlined in the TPI. All physical inspections have been completed and exactly match the TPI requirements.

JOB DESCRIPTION:
Diagnostic assessment and calibration of the Transmission Control Module (TCM). This procedure addresses the reported issue based on confirmed findings.

APPLICABLE TPI ENTRIES:
TPI 2083737/4 - Mechatronic Valve Body Solenoid Fault
- Symptom Alignment: Perfectly matches confirmed customer complaint and diagnostic findings.
- Operating Conditions: Confirmed present when driving over speed bumps below 30 km/h.
- Applicability: 2024-2026 Models.
- Prescribed Solution: Replace mechatronic unit and perform basic settings.
